notes.title: Playtest update 0.4.3
notes.notes:
This is likely the final update before the demo goes live next week (Which will essentially be the same as the current playtest). After the demo goes live I'll be working on unlocking the "full" game for the playtest version which will be available to test until the game is launched. Here's the change list:

[list]
[*]Fate cards have had their contrast bumped up considerably.
[*]Super Solider and Zealot have had new skills added for the full game but some changes to Tier 1 skill are added as well.
[*] Buffs and Debuffs now appear on separate rows. This will have a larger impact as more skills/abilities are added that specific interact with these two as separate entities.
[*] Added a bit of screenshake to certain events in the battle screen. I've also added a slider to turn this down if you don't like it.
[*] Rank outlines on health bars have been significantly improved and should be much more readable at a glance.
[*] Fixed a bug where stress levels on the 2nd level won't unlock.
[*] Fixed some issues with moving units around, this should be much smoother and more transparent.
[*] Locking is not directly on the unit themselves with a nice little icon button. Hopefully this makes it way more obvious that you have this utility at your disposal.
[/list]

notes.title: Playtest Update 0.4.2
notes.notes:
Got a handful of quick fixes based on the feedback I've received
[list]
[*]Level 2 has several adjustments to enemies to make it less of a large difficulty jump:
[*] Strange Goo reduced to 10 damage per stack (from 36)
[*] Crush extra damage if they have Entrench reduced to 0.6 + 8 (from 0.5 + 24)
[*] Oozing Pores and Entrench skills now heal on critical since their overall effects have been reduced drastically.
[*] Offerings have been reduced in power at rank 1 but now scale based on the unit's rank when they are sold.
[*] Added menu to battle so that you can concede or adjust settings in the middle of battle.
[*] Battle speed can be increased to 6x up from 4x.
[*] Fixed an issue with the Stun card locking the battle up and not letting units continue fighting.
[*] Units will give experience when appropriate to their rank (ie a rank 3 unit will give 3 exp when combined into another unit)
[*] Units that have an Artifact equipped will bring that over if they are combined into another unit that does NOT have an Artifact equipped. 
[/list]:

notes.title: Playtest Update 0.4.1
notes.notes:
Hey folks, this is possibly the biggest update I've done during the playtest! I'm very excited for you all to try it out!

[h2]New Unit: Machinist [/h2]
There's a whole new unit! This one has some fun summoner style game play. Machinist sacrifices their own arm during battles to provide a companion to help the party in a variety of ways. Love to hear what you think of this unit!

[h2]Stress level rework[/h2]
I wasn't happy with the accessibility of the stress system so I've redesigned it. Instead of multiple sliders to customize the difficulty you'll be rewarded with a single new stress level after you complete each level. This will add new stress skills to enemies to increase the difficulty while increasing the experience you're units gain substantially. I hope this system is a bit more straight forward in how you progress through the game.

[h2]Damage in Tooltip rework[/h2]
I'd heard that it's difficult to parse damage calculations so I've done a ton of work to make it so any unit that's utilizing a skill or ability to deal damage or heal will show the actual amount that will be dealt in the tooltip. There are a lot of fun calculations happening under the hood and you can still turn those on if you want to in the options. Sometimes knowing how things scale helps you make decisions about what to buy!

Many more changes, balance tweaks to sound effects.

Currently I'm considering this as a "demo" release candidate. I'm preparing to release a demo and then prepare that demo for a big marketing push during Steam Fest. Any feedback at this point is critical to getting the experience right so please jump into [url=https://discord.gg/hEGDEQn7Ac]Discord [/url]and let me know how it's working!

notes.title: Update 0.3.1
notes.notes:
A tutorial system has been added! Tips will appear, one time, to help fill in some parts of the game that I've seen players miss so far. I'll be adding these as I expand the game to make sure the new player experience is as smooth as possible.

Lots of performance optimizations.

notes.title: Playtest Update 0.2.0
notes.notes:
[h2][NEW] Offerings[/h2]
A new mechanic has been added to the game: Offerings. These are powerful skills that can be used one time to weaken a specific wave you're having trouble with. You can get these by selling units (along with the gold you receive).

I want to introduce more agency when a player feels like they are losing to specific enemy units. They could sell one of their current units to gain a powerful effect to turn the tide and keep their run going. These also encourage more rotation of units which is an interesting risk/reward choice that I'd love to see more thought put into.

Would love to hear feedback on how this changes your game play (Or if it doesn't at all)!

[h2]Balance changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] On Beach level. Several enemy's had their "On Crit" buffs toned down a bit. I want these to be impactful but I don't want the run to instantly be lost if someone randomly scores a crit off a low %.
[*] Strength and The Magician's stat changes have been toned down. These were leading to some enemies being very oppressive.
[*] Fixed an issue with the boss on the Beach level not keeping it's buff around for longer than a turn. This significantly changed how powerful it was so it felt much easier than it should have been. This issue might have been affecting other buffs as well.
[/list]

[h2]Quality of life and polish changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fullscreen and windowed mode is now fully supported. The interface should adapt appropriately to most sizes.
[*] There was a lot of optimization work that went into this one. I found quite a few ways the game was leaking memory as well as ways to make the game run smoother. Hopefully this translates to far less frame drops.
[*] New Fate viewer on main menu. Once you've "revealed" a fate you can see what it's effects are from the main menu. I know there's feedback that people want to be able to see these as they decide but I want to keep the "memorization" portion of this as a part of the game. I do recognize that people might forget from play sessions so I wanted to make it easy to review them before jumping into a run.
[*] Stress levels are a bit better explained in their interface. Additionally Stress levels won't appear until after you've completed level 0 so that new players don't get hung up on it too much.
[*] Added a link to patch notes on the main menu. For now this will link here but I will likely make these part of the game in the future.
[/list]

notes.title: Playtest Update 1
notes.notes:
[h2]Balance changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Units needed to upgrade now caps at 3. This makes it a little more achievable to get to rank 4. Previously felt like that was a bit of a waste of resources but getting to rank 4 should be fun and achievable during a run.
[*] Tactician and Blade Runner have had some abilities swapped to tune their unit's identity a little better.
[*] Acidic Flesh now accurately targets enemies instead of friendly party members.
[*] Enlighten and Refresh have swapped rarities.
[*] Inner Fire effect decreased but now stacks.
[*] Refresh hits two units for about half the power.
[*] Shield Bash damage multiplier lowered a bit.
[*] Expertise gained from items has been significantly increased to make it more appealing for units with damage over time effects.
[/list]

[h2]Quality of life and polish changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] New animated logo.
[*] Transitions between scenes.
[*] New hit bar animations.
[*] Rank is now shown with changes to the outline of the HP bar on units. This allows health to be a little easier to see as it has more space.
[*] Added option to show the full tooltip by default.
[*] Added option to pin tooltips to the bottom left instead of moving with the cursor.
[*] Added better feedback when you level up a skill in the skill tree.
[*] End of turn effects will now trigger on each unit separately. This should fix the "freeze" that would happen when a lot of end of turn effects would fire off all at once.
[/list]
